name: An SRXL2 ESC config reply of another version or length is refused
step: Check the SRXL2 ESC config codec and page
rationale:
The SRXL2 ESC page (Setup -> ESC & Motors -> SRXL2 ESC) saves by writing
back what it read, so a reply decoded in the wrong layout would be stored on the
flight controller at the next save. The reply starts with a payload version byte
for exactly that reason, and the first codec read it and ignored it, and decoded
any length. The wire sizes and command ids are pinned here against the firmware
handler (wingflight-firmware PR #257, MSP2_WING_SRXL2_ESC_CONFIG 0x5F35 /
MSP2_WING_SET_SRXL2_ESC_CONFIG 0x5F36): a 5-byte version-1 reply and a 4-byte
write. The harness also checks the 32 motor 2 channel choices, that the page
reboots after saving (the settings latch at boot) and refuses saves while armed,
and that the menu row's icon exists. Cases 3, 4 and 5 go red on the pre-fix codec.
Ported from rotorflight-lua-ethos-suite PR #2680.
